data.raw_text:
From Daily Tribune post an hour ago.

The sarcasm is so pungent and sharp I sooo fucking love it. 😅

YOU DON'T FIRE THE FACE CARD

Tourism Secretary Frasco. Most beautiful in the Cabinet. 

Tremendous public approval, 92 percent! Tourism booming, billions made, millions working. Total MVP. Marcos asked her to resign. Then asked her back. Embarrassing!

You don't bench your star libero mid-game. Unless you thought “Love the Philippines” was getting too much love. Call us, Christina. Let's build resorts.

And now. Her husband, Duke Frasco, deputy Speaker, Cebu kingpin, mysteriously didn't sign the Speaker’s loyalty pledge? Huh?

Maybe it’s nothing. Maybe it’s just a vacation from allegiance. Maybe it's a silent protest for Christina: You don’t fire a 92 percent woman and expect the husband to clap. 

Maybe he forgot his pen. Could’ve signed. Huge signature, very beautiful. But no pen! Maybe he didn't like the font. Maybe he's waiting for the real Speaker. The one who didn’t borrow power from a cousin.
